productBrief: cortex: A synthetic focus-group platform where AI personas with persistent memory debate products. Researchers define a target market; system mints archetype iNFTs encrypted on 0G Storage, spawns them as AXL peer-to-peer nodes, runs moderated multi-turn session, synthesizes findings. Personas accumulate skills across sessions. Key tensions: synthetic vs real insight, cost per session ($0.50), slower 0G Compute vs GPT-4, personas can only speak not act, session quality depends on archetype diversity.
contradictions: Panelists found the synthetic vs real insight tension interesting but ultimately disagreed on its value.
painPoints: High cost per session ($0.50) is seen as prohibitive.
Lack of tangible benefits or actionability in the insights provided.
Perceived abstraction and complexity of the platform.
opportunities: Explore ways to demonstrate the unique value of AI personas over traditional user research methods.
Reduce costs to make the platform more accessible.
Enhance the perceived relevance by showing how accumulated skills can lead to more insightful debates.
rawSummary: Panelists expressed significant concern about the high cost and lack of tangible benefits, finding the platform too complex and abstract. They suggested focusing on demonstrating unique value over traditional methods, reducing costs, and enhancing relevance.
